title: R33 towards Msinga, Greytown (map point approximate): station commander shot dead and two suspects killed in shootout after supermarket robbery, 12 Nov
summary: Greytown station commander Lt-Col TG Sithole was shot dead and Sergeant Gumede was shot in the arm in a gun battle on the R33 towards Msinga on the afternoon of Thursday 12 November, IOL and BNK News report from a SAPS s...
story: Greytown station commander Lt-Col TG Sithole was shot dead and Sergeant Gumede was shot in the arm in a gun battle on the R33 towards Msinga on the afternoon of Thursday 12 November, IOL and BNK News report from a SAPS statement. Police had responded to a business robbery at Lucky Supermarket in the Greytown CBD, where the shop owner was shot and injured and staff were assaulted; at least 10 suspects fled in a Toyota Quantum and were intercepted on the R33. Police shot two suspects dead, a third was wounded and arrested, and the rest fled on foot into the mountains. The map point is approximate: the Greytown town point, not the place on the R33.
incident: Thu 12 Nov 2026, afternoon (SAPS, via IOL and BNK News, both published Fri 13 Nov)
location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. R33 towards Msinga, after a robbery at Lucky Supermarket, Greytown CBD. The exact place on the R33 is not given; the pin is the Greytown town point (-29.0606, 30.5889). About 5 km.
